name: zusu-trading
description: ZuSu Trading — day-trading automation platform (DEMO / PAPER / LIVE)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @zusu/shared && npm run build -w @zusu/api && npm run build -w @zusu/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @zusu/api & npm run dev -w @zusu/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @zusu/shared && npm run typecheck -w @zusu/api && npm run typecheck -w @zusu/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @zusu/shared && npm run test -w @zusu/api && npm run test -w @zusu/web
